method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly). Benefits follow parent Huron and were not researched.
overview: Innosight is a growth and innovation strategy consultancy co-founded in 2000 by Clayton Christensen (disruptive innovation) and Mark Johnson. Huron acquired it in 2017; it still operates as Huron's strategy and innovation team and posts on Huron's careers board.
business_type: Growth and innovation strategy consulting inside a larger consultancy (Huron)
service_lines: Innovation strategy and new business models

differentiators.text: Built on disruptive-innovation theory (Christensen); work focuses on growth, new business models and navigating disruption, across sectors such as healthcare, energy, financial services and life sciences.
differentiators.significance: Future-focused strategy rather than cost or operations work.

differentiators.text: Huron's 2025 acquisition of Wilson Perumal was framed as building on the Innosight team's strategy and innovation strengths, indicating Innosight remains a distinct team.
differentiators.significance: The brand and team are still active within Huron.

unknowns: Entry-level program, benefits and flexibility (Huron's policies apply).

sources.title: Consulting Magazine: Huron to acquire Innosight
